title: Meet Anima at HETT Show 2026
summary: Anima’s announcement for HETT Show 2026, with details of the team’s stand at ExCeL London on 29 and 30 September.
body_markdown:
Anima is heading to HETT Show 2026 on 29 and 30 September at ExCeL London. You can find us at Stand H3.


## Meet the team


Come to the stand to talk about Anima and your organisation’s plans. If you would like to arrange a conversation in advance, contact our team.


[Contact Anima](https://www.animahealth.com/contact/sales)


[Register for HETT](https://www.hettshow.co.uk/registration)
